# MAGIC between user and item embeddings, excluding already interacted items.

import pandas as pd
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, lit, array, struct, explode
from pyspark.sql.types import StructType, StructField, StringType, FloatType, IntegerType
import numpy as np

# COMMAND ----------

# Define schema for embeddings
embedding_schema = StructType([
    StructField("id", StringType(), True),
    StructField("e1", FloatType(), True),
    StructField("e2", FloatType(), True),
    StructField("e3", FloatType(), True),
    StructField("e4", FloatType(), True),
    StructField("e5", FloatType(), True),
    StructField("e6", FloatType(), True),
    StructField("e7", FloatType(), True),
    StructField("e8", FloatType(), True)
])

# Read interactions
interactions_df = spark.read.csv("/dbfs/FileStore/tables/interactions.csv", header=True, inferSchema=True)

# Read user embeddings
user_emb_df = spark.read.csv("/dbfs/FileStore/tables/user_embeddings.csv", header=True, schema=embedding_schema)
user_emb_df = user_emb_df.withColumnRenamed("id", "user_id")

# Read item embeddings  
item_emb_df = spark.read.csv("/dbfs/FileStore/tables/item_embeddings.csv", header=True, schema=embedding_schema)
item_emb_df = item_emb_df.withColumnRenamed("id", "item_id")

# COMMAND ----------

user_emb_local = user_emb_df.collect()
user_emb_dict = {row.user_id: [row.e1, row.e2, row.e3, row.e4, row.e5, row.e6, row.e7, row.e8] for row in user_emb_local}

# Collect interactions per user
interactions_local = interactions_df.collect()
interacted_items = {}
for row in interactions_local:
    user_id = row.user_id
    item_id = row.item_id
    if user_id not in interacted_items:
        interacted_items[user_id] = set()
    interacted_items[user_id].add(item_id)

# Collect all item embeddings
item_emb_local = item_emb_df.collect()
item_emb_dict = {row.item_id: [row.e1, row.e2, row.e3, row.e4, row.e5, row.e6, row.e7, row.e8] for row in item_emb_local}

# COMMAND ----------

# Compute recommendations for each user
import itertools

results = []
for user_id, user_emb in user_emb_dict.items():
    user_interacted = interacted_items.get(user_id, set())

    for item_id, item_emb in item_emb_dict.items():

    # Sort by dot product descending, then by item_id ascending for ties
